label: disables feature for
type: turning off a parent toggle (e.g. Capella iQ) disables a named dependent feature (e.g. iQ Insights) for the affected scope
note: Distinct from requiresFlagToEnable (a single feature's own on/off gate) - this captures a dependency between two features' toggles. Close in shape to the separately-minted disablesDependentFeature (recurrence 2, watchlisted) - the two weren't merged since no page confirms they describe the same mechanism, not different ones (parent-disables-child vs. some other propagation shape); flagged for a future round to resolve with more evidence.
